architectureStudies.title: Enterprise HRIS Core Engine
architectureStudies.architecture: Java 21 Virtual Threads (Project Loom), Biometrics & Immutable Audit Engine

challenges.problem: I/O Blocking Bottlenecks pada jutaan log absensi bersamaan
challenges.solution: Mengadopsi Java 21 Virtual Threads untuk mengeksekusi thread ringan tanpa memory overhead berlebih.

challenges.problem: Kompleksitas multi-level cuti korporat dan manipulasi data
challenges.solution: Dynamic Approval Engine dengan expiry triggers otomatis dan tamper-evident audit log.
Biometric Face Recognition terintegrasi Geofencing GPS dan Liveness Detection anti-fraud.

architectureStudies.title: High-Throughput Centralized Master Data Hub
architectureStudies.architecture: Ultra Low-Latency Single Source of Truth with gRPC, Protobuf & Zero-Allocation Go

challenges.problem: Ukuran payload JSON besar dan latensi HTTP/1.1
challenges.solution: gRPC & Protocol Buffers memangkas ukuran paket data 60-80% via HTTP/2 binary multiplexing.

challenges.problem: Lonjakan konkurensi data hingga ratusan ribu request per detik
challenges.solution: Go Fiber & Fasthttp engine dengan zero memory allocation dan Goroutines asinkron.

challenges.problem: Inkonsistensi data saat terjadi transient network failure
challenges.solution: Idempotency Keys dengan Redis Cache-Aside pattern dan Append-Only transaction logging.

architectureStudies.title: Multi-Entity Financial Governance & Subsidiary Assessment
architectureStudies.architecture: Multi-Tenant Financial Analytics with Go Parallel Engine & Serializable Isolation

challenges.problem: Isolasi data antar anak perusahaan (multi-tenancy) yang ketat
challenges.solution: Dual-View Granular RBAC dengan claim JWT terenkripsi dan query tenant isolation di level database.

challenges.problem: Perhitungan rasio keuangan dan penilaian kesehatan korporasi memakan waktu
challenges.solution: Go parallel analytic engine mengevaluasi scoring matrix kesehatan anak perusahaan secara real-time.

challenges.problem: Race conditions pada penutupan buku kas akhir periode
challenges.solution: SERIALIZABLE isolation level database dengan pessimistic locks pada alur transaksional kritis.
